description: Brands (clients) and their saved context. view=brands (default): brands the caller can access with brand ID, name, workspace ID, source, and how many social accounts are assigned (optional workspace_id). view=brand (brand_id): one brand with its workspace, source, and linked legacy brand group. view=accounts (brand_id): the connected social accounts assigned to the brand; use it when a user refers to a brand name rather than an account handle. view=profile (brand_id): voice and tone, audience, keywords, dos and don’ts, and other saved brand context, plus Visual identity (hex colours, fonts, logo URLs).

brand_id.description: The brand ID (from view=brands). Required for brand, accounts, and profile.

workspace_id.description: view=brands: filter to brands in a specific workspace (get IDs via whoami).

name: list_brands
